notes.title: Update on FINAL FANTASY III (24th March 2020)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Following on from our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791435582731/announcements/detail/1693854792181370564]last update[/url] we’ve resolved the text overflow issue that many of you were experiencing while trying to play.

We’ve just released a patch which corrects this issue.

Thank you for your patience while we’ve worked through this, all of us on the team hope you continue to enjoy playing FINAL FANTASY III!

notes.title: Update on FINAL FANTASY III (28th February 2020)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
 
Thank you for your messages regarding the latest update.
We’re aware of an issue in which text appears to display outside of dialogue boxes in FINAL FANTASY III, and we are currently looking into this.
 
Thank you for your patience,
The FINAL FANTASY III team

notes.title: Huge FINAL FANTASY III Update - Out Now and 50% off for a limited time!
notes.content:
Whether it’s your first foray or if you’re a returning Warrior of Light, there’s never been a better time to jump into the adventure of a lifetime in FINAL FANTASY III!  

A big new update for FINAL FANTASY III has just been released with brand new features including;

・New languages added for the first time on STEAM!
     - Traditional Chinese
     - Simplified Chinese
     - Korean
     - Thai
     - Japanese

・BRAND NEW UI 

・Optimised controller settings

・Auto battle functions

・21:9 display setting

・Gallery Mode

To celebrate this update, for a limited time you can purchase FINAL FANTASY III for 50% off and bring light to the world once again.

notes.title: New patch released for Final Fantasy III
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have just made public a new version of Final Fantasy III. 

This patch will be applied by Steam automatically when you next start the game. If your game does not update, please restart the Steam client.

This patch will address the following issues:
1. Game could crash when users tried to start game with some types of game controllers plugged in.
2. Game could crash when no active sound device is detected on the PC.

If you are experiencing any issues, please use the contact form [url=http://support.eu.square-enix.com/main.php?la=2&id=518]here[/url]

Thanks
